name: Video Pages
intro: Video Pages turns a video into a branded landing page with a call to action, a lead form and analytics. My Video Pages, reached from Library, is where you manage them.

features.page-design: Start with page design. Choose a template, and the preview shows how your video and sections will look.
features.customer-personalisation: Attach a customer, and tokens in your page text are replaced with that customer's details, so you can send one page per prospect.
features.lead-form: The lead form sits next to your video. Visitors leave their details, and they show up in your contacts.

outro: That's Video Pages. Pick a design, personalize it, and let your video start collecting leads.
